description: Raw TSETMC cdn indexB2 payload for TEDPIX (CWI total index, insCode 32097828799138957). Fields: dEven (Gregorian yyyymmdd date), xNivInuClMresIbs (closing index level), xNivInuPbMresIbs, xNivInuPhMresIbs.
finpy-tse TEDPIX output for a two-week window. Indexed by Jalali date (J-Date); single column 'Adj Close' holds the index close level.

finpy_tse.Get_MarketWatch(save_excel=False) column inventory and sample rows (Ticker is the index). Confirms per-symbol Value/Market Cap/EPS are present and NO market P/E column exists; it is a current-day snapshot with no history.
